description: This file defines the OAuth2AuthCodesController class, which handles OAuth 2.0 authorization processes within a SuiteCRM module. It includes actions for authorization and confirmation flows, leveraging the Slim framework and OAuth2 server components.

classes.name: OAuth2AuthCodesController
classes.description: Controller class handling OAuth 2.0 authorization requests and user confirmations within SuiteCRM.

methods.description: Displays the authorization view for the OAuth process.
